change: ENGINE. medicham2-browser.js prices arrival k of a flat volley against the board arrival k-1 left behind, instead of pricing the whole volley once before any arrival lands. No new die is drawn: the roll INDEX each arrival already spent is stored at the price step and read back at the apply step. Knob MEDI_ARRIVAL_PRICE_ONCE=1 restores the old behaviour.

the_five: omit-spread ...2662243229 t11   Last Resort lands here and fails there
pair-protect-bust ...2653991758 t7   THE VOLLEY REPRICE — this fix is aimed at this game
pair-protect-bust ...2661266222 t6   a -hitcount on a one-hit Parental Bond click
pair-redirect-priority ...2654621676 t8   board cause still unidentified

prediction.diverged_protocol: 77 or lower; it is NOT predicted to rise
prediction.why_the_addressing_cannot_move: dmgRange draws no dice at all — no midEventDraw call exists anywhere in its body — and the re-price reads back the index the arrival already spent. So the middle arm's shared-address identity must be unchanged and mid_void.void_games must stay at 3.

how_it_could_be_wrong: MULTI-HIT IS COMMON. Dual Wingbeat alone is 6,800 corpus uses and the multiHit family is 14 moves. A volley that now deals more damage can KO a body a turn earlier and part boards in games that previously agreed — the last batch's residual v1 took the bar 9 -> 10 and was thrown away. Board-material RISING is a real outcome here and the fix is thrown away if it does.
The resist-berry half (RED-3) was not predicted before the probe found it. There may be a fourth thing this wire changes that no arm has staged.
A game may LEAVE on this cause and RE-ENTER on a leaf this fix uncovers. That is a TRANSFER, not a miss, and is reported as one.
Triple Axel and Parental Bond are refused by the flat-band gate, so any board they part is untouched. arrivalRepriceRefusedNonFlat says how often that happened.
throw_away_if: board_material > 5, or mid_void.void_games != 3 (which would mean the addressing moved and the pin with it)
